messages:
Allison (CEO): Quick thread for Q&A follow-ups after today's all-hands: partner GTM, pipeline signals, and next steps. Keep replies short.

Maya (Product): Two quick asks: do partners get route-level SLA metadata? And will we expose partner tags in the leadership pipeline view?

Ravi (Sales): Sales priority: yes on tags + partner-SLA. We need a visible "partner-influenced" flag in CRM. Without it, hard to report.

Elena (Partnerships): Enablement update: partner kit ready Thursday. Includes playbook, demo script, and integration checklist. Aiming for 2 pilot partners.

Priya (Rev Ops): Crediting proposal: referral = 30% Y1; influence = 20% if partner introduced first qualified touch and is not on contract. Draft policy by Tue.

Ben (GTM): I will build a saved leadership dashboard once the CRM fields exist. ETA to share link: next Tuesday.

Maya (Product): ETA for partner metadata in product?

Maya (Product): ETA: minimal fields (partner_tag, partner_sla, partner_influence) to staging in 3 weeks.

Ravi (Sales): Onboarding compression question: can we get from 8w to 4w for strategic partners?

Elena (Partnerships): Yes if Sales/Product provide a 2-week POA and commit AM time. Proposed timeline: 3w enablement + 1w tech onboarding.

ops-bot: File uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/allhands-partner-kit.pdf

Allison (CEO): Decisions: prioritize partners for regulated verticals; approve influence credit rule (20%); assign 3 AMs to partner program pilot. Priya to circulate formal policy.

Maya (Product): Action items recap: Product to add partner fields (3w), Ben to produce saved dashboard (after fields), Elena to run enablement pilot, Priya to publish crediting policy. Leaving thread open for quick clarifications. :thumbsup:
